violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §747.605(3))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission
violation_type.typical_finding: Three out of four children's files reviewed did not have a date of admission on the child admission form.

finding_variants.text: Three out of four children's files reviewed did not have a date of admission on the child admission form.
2 out of 11 children's files evaluated did not have an admission date on file.
One of the four children's admission forms was missing the child's admission date.
At the follow up visit, five children still did not have admission dates in their records.
None of the three children's record review have date of admission.
Four files reviewed was missing the date of admission.
